article.title: Why More Campaign Responses Do Not Necessarily Mean More Incremental Customers
article.why: Separate observed responses from behavior actually caused by the campaign.

paragraphs.en:
A campaign may generate more responses in the treatment group than in the control group, but that does not automatically mean every observed response was caused by the campaign. Some customers would have responded anyway. The business value of the campaign depends on the incremental difference, not simply the total number of responses among treated customers.

Suppose 100,000 customers receive a message and 2,000 respond. A naive report might say that the campaign generated 2,000 responses. But if a comparable control group of 100,000 customers produces 1,500 responses without the message, the incremental effect is only 500 additional responses. The other 1,500 were baseline behavior that likely would have happened even without treatment.

This distinction is especially important when treatment is targeted using a propensity model. High-score customers often have high natural response rates. If we contact only people already likely to buy, the treatment group may show impressive conversion even when the message itself has little effect. A control group lets us separate customer propensity from campaign contribution.

The denominator matters too. Comparing 2,000 responses out of 100,000 treated customers with 1,500 out of 80,000 control customers using raw counts would be misleading. We should compare rates or estimate treatment effects using equivalent assigned populations.

Costs can change the conclusion again. An incremental 500 responses may be valuable if the campaign is cheap and margins are high. The same 500 may be unattractive if contact costs, discounts, points, or service costs are large. Incremental profit, not gross response, is often the more relevant business metric.

There is also a timing issue. A campaign may accelerate purchases that would have occurred a few weeks later. Short-term response lift can therefore overstate long-term incremental value. Measuring outcomes over an appropriate follow-up window helps distinguish truly additional behavior from timing shifts.

For reporting, a useful sentence is: ‘The treatment group had a 2.0 percent response rate versus 1.5 percent in control, an incremental lift of 0.5 percentage points, equal to about 500 additional responses per 100,000 customers.’ This separates observed activity from the effect attributable to intervention.

Campaign responses are visible, but causality is not. The goal of an experiment is not merely to count what happened after treatment. It is to estimate what happened because of treatment.

Another useful measure is the number needed to treat. If the incremental response rate is 0.5 percentage points, roughly 200 customers must be treated to generate one additional response on average. That figure can be compared with contact cost and expected margin to judge whether scaling the campaign makes economic sense.

Segment analysis can reveal where the incremental effect comes from. The overall treatment-control difference may be 0.5 points, but perhaps it is 1.2 points among medium-propensity customers and almost zero among the highest-propensity group. That pattern would suggest that the campaign is most persuasive in the middle rather than among customers who were already likely to act. Such heterogeneity is often more actionable than the overall response count.

Finally, operational leakage should be checked. If control customers accidentally receive similar messages through another channel, the measured incremental difference will shrink. If treatment customers receive extra support unavailable to control, the estimate may combine several interventions. Clear experiment execution is therefore essential for turning response data into a causal business conclusion.
paragraphs.zh:
Treatment 群 response 較多，不代表每一個 response 都是 campaign 造成的。有些顧客本來就會反應，因此真正的 business value 應看 incremental difference，而不是 treated customers 的總 response 數。

例如10萬人收到訊息、2,000人回應，如果同樣10萬人的 control 在沒有訊息下也有1,500人回應，那 campaign 真正新增的只有500人，其餘1,500是 baseline behavior。

Propensity model targeting 時尤其重要。高分顧客原本 response rate 就高，因此 treatment conversion 可以很好看，但 message 本身可能幾乎沒有 effect。Control group 才能區分 customer propensity 與 campaign contribution。

Denominator 也必須一致。若 treatment 是2,000/100,000，control 卻是1,500/80,000，就不能只比 raw count，而應比較 rate 或 equivalent assigned population 的 treatment effect。

成本會再次改變結論。500個 incremental responses 若 campaign 很便宜且 margin 高，可能很有價值；若 contact、discount、points、service cost 很高，就未必划算。Incremental profit 往往比 gross response 更重要。

時間也會造成誤判。Campaign 可能只是把原本幾週後會發生的購買提前，因此短期 lift 可能高估 long-term incremental value。

報告可寫成：「Treatment response 2.0%，control 1.5%，incremental lift 0.5 percentage points，相當於每10萬人約多500個 responses。」這能區分 observed activity 與 intervention effect。

Response 看得見，causality 看不見。Experiment 的目的不是只計數 treatment 後發生多少，而是估計多少是因 treatment 才發生。

還可看 number needed to treat。若 incremental rate 是0.5個百分點，平均約需 treatment 200人才能多1個 response，可直接與 contact cost 和 margin 比較。

Segment analysis 可能發現中 propensity 群 lift 1.2 points，而最高 propensity 幾乎為0，表示真正可被說服的可能在中間。

最後也要檢查 operational leakage。Control 若從其他 channel 收到類似訊息，effect 會被稀釋；treatment 若額外獲得其他支援，估計值就混入多個 intervention。
paragraphs.ja:
treatment groupのresponseが多くても、観測されたresponseすべてがcampaignによって生じたとは限りません。何もしなくても反応した顧客がいるため、重要なのはtreated内の総数ではなくincremental differenceです。

例えば10万人へmessageを送り2,000人がresponseしても、同規模controlで1,500人が自然にresponseするなら、追加効果は500人です。残り1,500人はbaseline behaviorです。

propensity modelで高score顧客をtargetingすると、この問題はさらに重要です。高score層は自然response率も高いため、treated conversionが高くてもmessage effectが小さいことがあります。controlがpropensityとcampaign contributionを分けます。

denominatorもそろえる必要があります。treated 10万人中2千人とcontrol 8万人中1,500人をraw countだけで比較すべきではありません。rateまたは同等のassigned populationでeffectを推定します。

costを入れると結論も変わります。incremental 500件でもcontact costやdiscount、points、service costが高ければ魅力は下がります。gross responseよりincremental profitが重要な場合があります。

またcampaignが購入を数週間前倒ししただけなら、短期liftはlong-term valueを過大評価します。適切なfollow-up windowが必要です。

報告では「treatment 2.0％、control 1.5％、incremental lift 0.5pt、10万人当たり約500件の追加response」と表現すると明確です。

responseは観測できますがcausalityは直接見えません。experimentはtreatment後に起きたことではなく、treatmentによって起きたことを推定します。

number needed to treatも有効です。0.5ptのincremental rateなら平均200人をtreatして1件追加responseとなり、costやmarginと比較できます。

segment別ではmedium propensityで1.2pt、最高score層でほぼ0という場合もあり、persuadable層が中間にいる可能性があります。

controlへの別channel配信などoperational leakageがあるとeffectは縮みます。experiment executionの品質もcausal interpretationに不可欠です。

business.term: Observed responses are not the same as incremental responses.

business.term: Measure what happened because of treatment, not merely after treatment.
